title: Sources: China's Salt Typhoon accessed the emails of staff on powerful US House committees, detected last December, and intercepted senior US officials' calls (Demetri Sevastopulo/Financial Times)
summary: Demetri Sevastopulo / Financial Times: Sources: China's Salt Typhoon accessed the emails of staff on powerful US House committees, detected last December, and intercepted senior US officials' calls — Beijing's intelligence used Salt Typhoon to access communications used by top panels in US Congress
